2. Paths and dir
```{r}
setwd("/Users/putriramadani/Documents/GitHub/PTCL-NOS_subtyping")

root <- normalizePath(".")   

data_dir <- file.path(root, "data")
fig_dir  <- file.path(root, "figures")
res_dir  <- file.path(root, "result")

counts_file <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE58445_RAW.tar")
soft_file   <- file.path(data_dir, "GSE58445_family.soft.gz")
```

3. Load and read counts_file
```{r}
exdir <- file.path(data_dir, "cel_raw") 
dir.create(exdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# .CEL.gz files are Affymetrix microarray raw data, not a count table, 
# so read.delim() won't work on them and there are no counts to merge


# --- 1. extract and list cel files ---
untar(counts_file, exdir = file.path(data_dir, "cel_raw"))

cel_files <- list.files(file.path(data_dir, "cel_raw"),
                        pattern = "\\.CEL(\\.gz)?$",
                        full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE,
                        ignore.case = TRUE)
length(cel_files)
# [1] 193


# --- 2. check what array platform ---
library(affyio)
read.celfile.header(cel_files[1])$cdfName
#[1] "HG-U133_Plus_2" 


library(affy)
raw  <- ReadAffy(filenames = cel_files)   # reads .gz directly
eset <- rma(raw)                          # background correction + quantile norm + summarization
expr <- exprs(eset)                       # probesets x samples, log2 scale
# --- output message ---:
# Background correcting
# Normalizing
# Calculating Expression
# ----------------------


# clean sample names to GSM IDs
colnames(expr) <- sub("_.*", "", basename(cel_files))
dim(expr)
# [1] 54675   193
# 56475 rows = probesets (features on the array)
# 193 = columns = samples, one per CEL file



# 3. --- Map probes to gene symbols ---
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(hgu133plus2.db)

map <- AnnotationDbi::select(hgu133plus2.db, keys = rownames(expr),
                             columns = "SYMBOL", keytype = "PROBEID")
map <- map[!is.na(map$SYMBOL) & !duplicated(map$PROBEID), ]

expr_gene <- expr[map$PROBEID, ]
# collapse multiple probes per gene by mean
expr_gene <- rowsum(expr_gene, group = map$SYMBOL) / as.vector(table(map$SYMBOL)[rownames(rowsum(expr_gene, map$SYMBOL))])


# 4. --- save ---
saveRDS(expr_gene, file.path(res_dir, "expr_gene_rma.rds"))
write.csv(expr_gene, file.path(res_dir, "expr_gene_rma.csv"))

```
Since this is microarray data, downstream analyses should use log2 expression, so use limma for differential expression rather than DESeq2 or edgeR.
